paite: Apa mikhual a a-omna gam Kanaan ah Jakob ateng hi.
heading: Joseph Leh Asanggamte
english: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

paite: Hiaite Jakob suante ahi uh. Joseph, kum sawm-le-sagih a upa ahih in, asanggamte toh ganhon akhah uhi. Amah naupang ahi lai a, apa' zite Bilhah leh Zilpah tapate kiang ah a-om a; Joseph in agitlouhna thu uh apa uh kiang ah atun hi.
english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

paite: Israel in Joseph, atek lam ta ahih ziak in atapate tengteng sang in a-itzaw a; puanaktual ze tuamtuam a gial abawlsak hi.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a coat of many colors.

paite: Apa un asanggamte tengteng sang in amah a-itzaw chih asanggamte'n athei uhi; amah amudah ua, kampha himhim in ahoupih thei kei uhi.
english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

paite: Joseph in mang anei a, asanggamte ahilh a, amah amudah semsem uhi.
english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, “Hehpih in ka mang ngai dih uh.
english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

paite: Ngai un, lou ah buhphalte i na gak ua, ngai dih uh, kei buhphal athoutou a, adingh nemnom hi. Ngai un, nou buhphalte'n ahong um ua, kei buhphal ma ah akun chiat uh," achi hi.
english: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

paite: Asanggamte'n akiang ah, "Nang sop lai in ka tung uah vai na hawm mahmah ding maw? Nang sop lai in ka tung uah thu na nei mahmah ding maw?" achi uh. Huchi in amang ziak in amah amudah semsem uhi.
english: His brothers said to him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Or will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

paite: Mang dang anei nawn a, asanggamte ahilh nawn hi, "Ngai un, mang ka nei nawn hi. Ni, kha leh aksi sawm-le-khatte ka mai ah akun uhi," achi hi.
english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

paite: Apa leh asanggamte ahilh hi. Apa'n atai a, akiang ah, "Mang na neih bangchi mang ahia? Kei leh na nu leh na sanggamte lei si in na mai ah ka kun taktak ding uh maw?" achi hi.
english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to you to the earth?”

paite: Asanggamte'n amah ahaza ua, apa'n bel athugen alungsim in apai nilouh hi.
english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

paite: Asanggamte Shekem ah apa uh ganhon khah in ahoh uhi.
heading: Joseph Zuakna Leh Aigupta A Pina
english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

paite: Israel in Joseph kiang ah, "Na sanggamte'n Shekem ah ahi maw ganhon akhah uh? Hong pai dih, akiang uah ka hon sawl ding," achi hi. Huan ama'n, "Hiai ah ka om," achi hi.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

paite: Ama'n akiang ah, "Na sanggamte adamdam na uhiam, ganhon leng adamdam na hiam va en inla, atanchin uh hong hilh nawn in," achi hi. Hebron Phaizang a kipan asawlkhia a, Shekem ava pha hi.
english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

paite: Mi kuahiam in amah gamlak a vakvak amu hi. Huai mi'n, "Bang zong na hia?" chi in adong hi.
english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

paite: Ama'n, "Ka sanggamte zong ka hi. Hehpih in ganhon akhahna uh hon hilh ve," achi hi.
english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

paite: Huai mi'n, “Hiai a kipan pawt hi ve un, Dothan ah i hoh ding uh, achih uh ka za,” achi hi. Joseph in asanggamte adelhzui a, Dothan ah ava mu hi.
english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

paite: Amau gamlapi a kipan ana galmuh ua, akiangnai uh atun ma in, amah thah ana sawm khin uhi.
english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

paite: Amau, "En un, hiai ah mang neipa ahong pai.
english: They said one to another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

paite: Hong un, i that ding ua, kokhuk khat ah i khe ding uh. Gamsa gilou in ane, chi na ni. Amangte bangchibang in a-om a, chih i thei mai ding uh," akichi uhi.
english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

paite: Reuben in huai ana za a, akhut ua pan ahunkheta hi. "Thah zaw i that hial kei ding uh," achi hi.
english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

paite: Reuben mah in apa uh kiang a, apitheihna ding a, akhut ua pan ahotkhiak theihna ding in, akiang uah, "Sisan zaw suah kei un, gamdai ah kokhuk ah khia un, atung ah khut kha kei un," achi hi.
english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, Joseph asanggamte kiang atun in, Joseph puanaktual ze tuamtuam a gial asilh, ana suahsak uhi.
english: It happened, when Joseph came to his brothers, that they stripped Joseph of his coat, the coat of many colors that was on him;

paite: Amah api ua, kokhuk ah akheta uhi. Huai kokhuk avuak ahi a, tui om louhna ahi.
english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

paite: An ne ding in atu chiat ua, adak ua, a-en ua, ngai in, Gilead gam a kipan Ishmael khualzin mite, asangawngsau ua thil gimnamtui, singnai damdawi leh murrah pua in Aigupta gam a paisuk dingte ahong pai uhi.
english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites was coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

paite: Judah in asanggamte kiang ah, "I naupa uh i thah ua, asisan suak i iim un bang phattuamna om ding ahia?
english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

paite: Hong un, atung a khut kha lou in, Ishmaelte kiang ah i zuak zaw ding uh; amah lah i sanggam uh, i sa ngeingei uh ahi ngal a," achi hi. Huchi in asanggamte'n athu azuita uhi.
english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

paite: Midian sumsin mite ahong pai ua; kokhuk a kipan Joseph akaikhia ua, Ishmaelte kiang ah dangka sawmnih in Joseph akhawngta uhi. Amau Aigupta gam ah Joseph api uhi.
english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. They brought Joseph into Egypt.

paite: Kokhuk ah Reuben ahong pai nawn a, ngai in, kokhuk ah Joseph ana omta kei a; apuansilhte abotkek hi.
english: Reuben returned to the pit; and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

paite: Asanggamte kiang ah ahong kik nawn a, "I naupa uh a-om nawn kei. Kei koi a paita ding ka hia oi?" achi hi.
english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

paite: Joseph puanaktual ala ua, kelnou agou ua, asi ah apuanaktual adiah uhi.
english: They took Joseph’s coat, and killed a male goat, and dipped the coat in the blood.

paite: Huai puanaktual ze tuamtuam a gial akhak ua, apa uh kiang ah ahon la ua, "Hiai lel ka mu ua, na tapa puanaktual ahi hia, hilou, en mah dih," achi uh.
english: They took the coat of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, whether it is your son’s coat or not.”

paite: Ama'n ana thei pah a, "Ka tapa puanaktual ahi ve. Gamsa gilou in ne ahi ve. Joseph bohnen vek a om hi mahmah ding ahi ve," achi hi.
english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s coat. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

paite: Jakob in apuansilhte abotkek a, sai-ip puan ateng a, ni tamtak atapa asuun hi.
english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

paite: Atapa tengteng leh atanu tengteng amah lungmuan ding in athou ua; himahleh amah lungmuan a-ut kei, "Suun kawm in han ah ka tapa kiang ah ka paisuk ding," achi hi. Amah ngai in apa akap hi.
english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol Sheol is the place of the dead. to my son mourning.” His father wept for him.

paite: Midiante'n Aigupta gam ah Joseph alutpih ua, Pharaoh nuai a heutu khat, vengmi pawl heutu Potiphar kiang ah azuak uhi.
english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.
